claim_boundary: Closes #479 by requiring content-bound DurablePersistenceAcknowledgement before MATERIALIZED or ALREADY_MATERIALIZED hook status. Without ack the hook returns BUILT_NOT_PERSISTED; stale, hash-mismatched, or late ack returns CANNOT_CHECK. Does not validate chronology improvement QoI, mint prospective credit, or authorize protected host integration.
prior_vulnerability: run_pre_scratch_fibre_freeze_hook returned MATERIALIZED from in-memory receipt build with caller-supplied timestamp and no durable write
fix_summary: MATERIALIZED/ALREADY_MATERIALIZED require exact receipt hash match, storage pointer, and persisted_at_utc strictly before hook invocation; new BUILT_NOT_PERSISTED terminal for receipt-built-without-ack.
